proof_body:
by
  intro x y
  have h1 := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq x
  have h2 := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq y
  rw [Real.sin_add, Real.sin_sub, Real.cos_add, Real.cos_sub]
  constructor
  · linear_combination Real.sin x ^ 2 * h2 - Real.sin y ^ 2 * h1
  · linear_combination Real.cos x ^ 2 * h2 - Real.sin y ^ 2 * h1
target_source: ∀ x y : ℝ, Real.sin (x + y) * Real.sin (x - y) = Real.sin x ^ 2 - Real.sin y ^ 2 ∧ Real.cos (x + y) * Real.cos (x - y) = Real.cos x ^ 2 - Real.sin y ^ 2
